news.title: Chandigarh administration eyes CHB land to bankroll periphery expansion
news.para: Chandigarh's administration is developing a strategy to monetize land owned by the Chandigarh Housing Board located in IT Park. The generated revenue will facilitate the acquisition of about 1,750 acres from nearby villages, with an anticipated expense of Rs 14,000 crore. Some portions of land are earmarked for public facilities and infrastructure, aiming to bolster planned urban growth by capitalizing on the value of government properties.

news.title: Trichy leads in property tax collection for FY27
news.para: The Trichy corporation proudly announces a 55.4% collection of the current property tax demand for the fiscal year 2026-27. By publicly exposing the top 100 property tax defaulters online, they have successfully spurred long-time non-payers into action. Additionally, the disconnection of water and sewage services has further boosted collection rates.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh set to pilot 3D-printed houses under PMAY-Gramin
news.para: The Andhra Pradesh government plans to leverage 3D printing technology for the construction of housing under PMAY-G. A project to build approximately 100 homes in Burripalem village is underway, with technical support from CBRI. Eligible beneficiaries will receive financial assistance between ₹1.70 lakh and ₹1.80 lakh. This cutting-edge technology is designed to greatly reduce both construction time and costs, while enhancing thermal comfort in the homes created.

news.title: Indian design must absorb global influences without losing cultural identity: Sunita Kohli
news.para: Speaking at The Economic Times DesignScape Summit & Awards 2026, Padma Shri Sunita Kohli, President and Co-Founder, K2India, said contemporary Indian design should reinterpret global ideas through local craft, materials, climate and cultural knowledge rather than merely imitate international trends.

news.title: Ahmedabad: Seven illegally constructed residential units in Fatehwadi razed
news.para: In a decisive move on Wednesday, the estate department of Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation took action against unauthorized construction by demolishing seven row houses in Fatehwadi. This followed a formal notice to property owners demanding the removal of illegal structures, which they ignored, prompting further action when the builder unlawfully resumed operations. Ultimately, the demolition eliminated over 7,100 square feet of violations.

news.title: Aadhaar mandatory for property transactions in Maharashtra from October 1
news.para: Starting October 1, Maharashtra mandates Aadhaar identification for various document registrations, aiming to eliminate fraudulent property dealings and minimize the necessity of physical witnesses. Those lacking an Aadhaar number can utilize an alternative verification method to complete their transactions. Officials affirm that technical measures will be in place to guarantee smooth verification, striking a balance between fostering genuine transactions and enforcing stringent identity checks.

news.title: Property owners in Gurugram seek policy for commercial conversion of housing units
news.para: Over fifty property owners from Golf Course Road convened with town planner Amit Madholia to voice their concerns. They are advocating for a commercial conversion policy that permits conversion charge payments and adherence to regulations. The owners contend that the area's character has been notably altered due to increased traffic and development.

news.title: Complete redevelopment in two years from plinth stage: Maharashtra government
news.para: Maharashtra's new redevelopment framework mandates that developers complete their projects within two years after receiving foundation approval. In this initiative, developers are required to secure competitive bids and enter into agreements swiftly. Society members will enjoy complimentary access to essential redevelopment documents. Quick decisions regarding new memberships and flat allocations are prioritized, while commercial tenants are granted extra protections to uphold their rights throughout the redevelopment process.

news.title: Maharashtra housing redevelopment gets stricter: Three bids, registered rehab agreements and two-year deadline
news.para: Maharashtra's revised redevelopment framework emphasizes tracking project progress and providing safeguards for housing societies. Societies are now required to obtain project management reports within two months and must evaluate three developer bids. Members will have the right to inspect records related to redevelopment free of charge, which promotes transparency in the process. Developers must sign agreements within three months, with projects expected to complete in two years.

news.title: Haryana RERA directs Agrante Realty to pay 10.8% interest over delayed Kavyam possession
news.para: Agrante Realty is now under the scrutiny of the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority for failing to deliver promised apartments on time. As a consequence of this three-year delay past the August 2023 possession deadline, the authority has ruled that the promoter owes two allottees compensation at an interest rate of 10.8% per annum.

news.title: Enforcement directorate search at TDI’s Mohali office ends after 53 hours
news.para: Following a thorough 53-hour operation, the Enforcement Directorate has concluded its search at TDI House concerning land acquisition irregularities. During this time, officials examined numerous land documents, records, and digital files while questioning on-site staff. The investigation targets two key areas: excessive compensation and a fraudulent government fund scheme. As of now, the ED has yet to release any official updates on the findings of this significant search.

news.title: L&T extends completion date for Hyderabad metro project stake sale to December 31
news.para: Larsen & Toubro has decided to push back the timeline for divesting its stake in L&T Metro Rail, from an original June deadline to December 31. This shift comes amid various challenges, including financial hurdles and regulatory roadblocks. The company has also undergone delays in securing financial aid from the Telangana government, highlighting the ongoing operational difficulties affecting the Hyderabad metro project.

news.title: Wadhwa Group Holdings files IPO papers with Sebi through confidential route
news.para: Wadhwa Group Holdings Ltd has taken a significant step by submitting preliminary IPO papers to Sebi. This confidentiality strategy enables them to withhold essential information from the public until a later stage. With over 250 projects in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, their expansive portfolio covers around 45 million square feet, serving more than 35,000 customers. This IPO move reflects their ambition to enter the public market.

news.title: Gurugram admin acts against 71 builders for failing to refund amounts ordered by Haryana RERA
news.para: The Gurugram district administration has initiated recovery actions targeting 71 builders for unpaid penalties and refunds, amounting to a staggering Rs 446 crore. This initiative comes after a thorough assessment of long-pending recovery certificates that lingered without action for years. The Deputy Commissioner indicated that if these recovery efforts are thwarted, more stringent measures may follow.

news.title: ED arrests two promoters of Gurugram-based Vatika Group in homebuyers 'fraud' case
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate took action against Anil Bhalla and Gautam Bhalla, the directors of Vatika Group, arresting them on September 28. This move stems from a money laundering investigation linked to fraudulent dealings with homebuyers, prompted by a Delhi Police Economic Offences Wing FIR. Allegations focus on the failure to deliver residential plots, with around Rs 140.73 crore in payments still unfulfilled to buyers.

news.title: HDFC Capital, Shalimar Corp form ₹750 crore housing platform for Uttar Pradesh
news.para: HDFC Capital Advisors and Shalimar Corp have formed a ₹750 crore platform to develop residential and mixed-use projects across Lucknow, Varanasi and Kanpur. The platform will have a development potential of over five million sq ft and around 3,000 homes.

news.title: Architecture must combine nature, context and technology to redefine luxury: Nilanjan Bhowal
news.para: Speaking at The Economic Times DesignScape Summit & Awards 2026, Nilanjan Bhowal, Principal Architect, Design Consortium, said luxury architecture should move beyond material excess and use technology to create buildings that respond meaningfully to climate, culture and place.

news.title: Better documentation, coordination can reduce costly design mistakes: Architects
news.para: At The Economic Times DesignScape Summit & Awards 2026, architects said stronger drawings, early coordination, clearer project leadership and better communication can prevent design and construction errors, while acknowledging that mistakes remain an important part of professional learning.

news.title: Designers must think like CEOs, build trust and charge for value: Lipika Sud
news.para: Speaking at The Economic Times DesignScape Summit & Awards 2026, Lipika Sud, Director and Principal Designer, Lipika Sud Interiors, said sustainable design practices require business thinking, stronger client relationships, collaboration, effective delegation and disciplined pricing.

news.title: Indian design must look beyond Instagram aesthetics to context, experience and identity: Architects
news.para: At The Economic Times DesignScape Summit & Awards 2026, architects said social media can increase visibility for design practices, but architecture should continue to be shaped by context, function, climate, experience and long-term relevance rather than visual impact alone.
